title: Turn off Game DVR and the Game Bar controller button
description: Turns off Game DVR background capture and stops the controller button from opening Game Bar. The Game Bar app stays installed, and Win + G may still open it.
details:
HKCU\System\GameConfigStore: GameDVR_Enabled = 0
HKCU\...\CurrentVersion\GameDVR: AppCaptureEnabled = 0
HKCU\Software\Microsoft\GameBar: UseNexusForGameBarEnabled = 0
HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR: AllowGameDVR = 0

title: High-performance power plan
description: Creates and activates the "MyTune Performance" plan: no core parking on mains power, USB power saving off, and no sleep on mains power. The display still turns off on the timer of the Windows plan it copies.
details:
Creates power plan 8e3f2a71-5c1b-4d7e-9a2f-6d795475e001 (a copy of High performance or Balanced with tuned processor, USB and sleep settings; desktops also turn PCIe power saving off) and makes it active. On desktops the cooling policy is Active on mains power.
Your previous plan is remembered and restored when you turn this off.
Laptops keep sleep and hibernate on battery, allow core parking there and use a 5% minimum CPU state. USB power saving stays off on battery.

title: NVIDIA low-latency profile
description: Sets the global NVIDIA driver profile to favor low latency over image quality. Anisotropic filtering is off and texture filtering is set to high performance for every game without its own setting.
details:
NVIDIA Base Profile:
• Power management: prefer maximum performance
• Low latency mode: on (1 pre-rendered frame)
• Vertical sync: off
• Triple buffering: off
• Preferred refresh rate: highest available
• Texture filtering quality: high performance
• Trilinear optimization: on
• Anisotropic filter optimization: on
• Anisotropic sample optimization: on
• Shader cache size: unlimited
• FXAA: off
• Ansel: off (older drivers only)
• Anisotropic filtering: set by the driver
• Anisotropic filtering: off
• Antialiasing transparency: off
• Antialiasing transparency supersampling: off
• OpenGL GDI compatibility: prefer performance
• Threaded optimization: on
• Texture filtering negative LOD bias: clamp
G-SYNC and per-game profiles you set yourself are not touched.

title: Limit Microsoft telemetry
description: Sets diagnostic data to the lowest level your edition allows (Required on Home and Pro) and disables the DiagTrack and dmwappushservice services from the next restart.
details:
HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection: AllowTelemetry = 0 (acts as 1, Required, on Home and Pro)
Services DiagTrack and dmwappushservice: Disabled. They are not stopped now and keep running until you restart.

title: Best-performance visual effects
description: Turns off Windows animations and visual effects. Font smoothing stays on.
details:
HKCU\...\Explorer\VisualEffects: VisualFXSetting = 2
HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop: UserPreferencesMask = 90 12 03 80 10 00 00 00
HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop\WindowMetrics: MinAnimate = 0
HKCU\...\Explorer\Advanced: TaskbarAnimations = 0

title: Disable automatic Windows Update
description: Stops Windows from downloading and installing updates on its own. Security updates stop arriving until you update by hand in Settings.

title: Disable automatic Microsoft Store updates
description: Stops Store apps from updating in the background while you play.

title: 0.5 ms timer resolution while gaming
description: Raises the Windows timer resolution while a Game Hub game is running, for smoother frame pacing. Works while MyTune is running (it keeps running in the tray).
details:
Calls NtSetTimerResolution(0.5 ms) when a game from Game Hub starts and releases it when the last one closes.
HKLM\...\Session Manager\kernel: GlobalTimerResolutionRequests = 1 (so Windows 11 honours it while MyTune is in the tray)

title: Disable background apps
description: Stops Store apps from running in the background.

title: Disable Copilot and Recall
description: Sets the policies that turn off Windows Copilot, its taskbar button and Recall snapshots. The Copilot policy is a legacy one and may not affect the newer Copilot app.
details:
HKLM + HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot: TurnOffWindowsCopilot = 1
HKCU\...\Explorer\Advanced: ShowCopilotButton = 0
HKLM + HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI: DisableAIDataAnalysis = 1
HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI: AllowRecallEnablement = 0
Microsoft marks TurnOffWindowsCopilot as deprecated. The Recall policies apply from Windows 11 24H2.

title: Disable Storage Sense
description: Sets the Storage Sense switch to off, which is meant to stop Windows from cleaning up files automatically.
details:
HKCU\...\StorageSense\Parameters\StoragePolicy: 01 = 0
Without a backup, turning this off deletes the value so Windows uses its default.

title: Disable notification center and calendar
description: Removes the notification center and calendar flyout from the taskbar. Explorer restarts.

title: Disable hibernation and Fast Startup
description: Removes hiberfil.sys (frees several GB) and makes every shutdown a clean one.
details:
Runs: powercfg /hibernate off
Turning it off restores hibernation and its file type only if hibernation was on before.

title: Classic right-click menu
description: Brings back the full Windows 10 right-click menu without "Show more options". Explorer restarts.
details:
Creates HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{86ca1aa0-34aa-4e8b-a509-50c905bae2a2}\InprocServer32 with an empty default value.
Without a MyTune backup, turning this off deletes that CLSID key, which brings the Windows 11 menu back.

title: Microsoft Edge debloat
description: Stops Edge running in the background and turns off its sidebar, shopping and recommendation pop-ups.
details: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge: StartupBoostEnabled = 0, BackgroundModeEnabled = 0, HubsSidebarEnabled = 0, EdgeShoppingAssistantEnabled = 0, ShowRecommendationsEnabled = 0, PersonalizationReportingEnabled = 0, UserFeedbackAllowed = 0, DiagnosticData = 0

title: Brave debloat
description: Turns off Brave Rewards, Wallet, VPN and AI Chat.

title: Optimizations for windowed games
description: Lets borderless and windowed games use the faster flip presentation path (lower latency), close to exclusive fullscreen.
details: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences: DirectXUserGlobalSettings gets SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1; (other entries in that value are kept)

title: Turn off multiplane overlay
description: Sets OverlayTestMode = 5, an unofficial way to turn off MPO. MPO has been linked to stutter, flicker and black screens in some games, but reports on Windows 11 24H2 and later are mixed.

title: Turn off hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
description: Turns HAGS off. Frame pacing can get better or worse depending on the game, and DLSS Frame Generation needs HAGS on.
details:
HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers: HwSchMode = 1 (off)
Without a backup, turning this off deletes the value so the Windows and driver default applies.

title: MSI mode for GPU and network adapter
description: Turns on message-signaled interrupts for your graphics card and network adapter. Many drivers already use MSI. A device that cannot use it may fail after the restart.
details:
For each PCI graphics and network device that already has the key HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\<device>\Device Parameters\Interrupt Management\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties: MSISupported = 1
Devices without that key, or whose driver set the value to 0, are skipped.
Original values are restored when you turn this off.
If Windows no longer starts: boot into Safe Mode, open regedit, set MSISupported to 0 for that device, then restart.

title: Disable Virtualization-Based Security
description: Turns off VBS, Memory Integrity and the hypervisor. This lowers protection against malware and stops features that need the hypervisor, such as WSL 2, Hyper-V and Windows Sandbox. Valorant (Vanguard) and some anti-cheats need VBS on.
details:
HKLM\...\DeviceGuard: EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity = 0
HKLM\...\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity: Enabled = 0
bcdedit /set hypervisorlaunchtype off (previous value is remembered)

title: Adapter power management off
description: Keeps your network adapter at full power instead of letting it sleep. The connection drops for a few seconds when applied.
details: Driver settings (only those your adapter has): *DeviceSleepOnDisconnect, *SelectiveSuspend, ReduceSpeedOnPowerDown, ULPMode = 0

title: Adapter latency tuning
description: Turns off interrupt moderation, flow control and Energy-Efficient Ethernet. The connection drops for a few seconds when applied.
details: Driver settings (only those your adapter has): *InterruptModeration, *FlowControl, *EEE, EEELinkAdvertisement, AdvancedEEE, EnableGreenEthernet, GreenEthernet = 0

title: Wi-Fi latency tuning
description: Asks the Wi-Fi driver to prefer 5 and 6 GHz networks and scan less for other access points. Best on a PC that stays in one place. Wi-Fi drops for a few seconds when applied.
details:
Driver settings (only those your Wi-Fi adapter has): RoamingPreferredBandType = 4, RoamAggressiveness = 0
These values come from an Intel driver. Other drivers may treat them differently.

title: Larger adapter buffers
description: Doubles your network adapter's receive and transmit buffers, up to what the driver allows, so fewer packets are dropped in bursts. Uses a little more memory. The connection drops for a few seconds when applied.
details: Driver settings (only those your adapter has): *ReceiveBuffers, *TransmitBuffers = twice the driver default, capped at the driver's maximum

title: Unbind unused protocols
description: Turns off network discovery protocols (LLTD and LLDP) that games never use.
details:
Disable-NetAdapterBinding for ms_lltdio, ms_rspndr and ms_lldp on each enabled Ethernet or Wi-Fi adapter, connected or not.
File and printer sharing stay on.

title: Disable advertising ID
description: Stops apps from using a personal advertising ID to track you across apps.

title: Remove ads, suggestions and auto-installed apps
description: Turns off Start menu and lock screen ads, Settings suggestions, Windows Spotlight tips and the sponsored apps Windows installs on its own. The two policy values may do nothing on Windows Pro.
details:
HKCU\...\ContentDeliveryManager: ContentDeliveryAllowed, SystemPaneSuggestionsEnabled, SilentInstalledAppsEnabled, PreInstalledAppsEnabled, OemPreInstalledAppsEnabled, SoftLandingEnabled, RotatingLockScreenOverlayEnabled, SubscribedContent-* = 0
HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent: DisableWindowsSpotlightFeatures = 1
HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent: DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures = 1

title: Turn off activity history and Timeline
description: Stops Windows from recording which apps and files you open and uploading it to Microsoft.

title: Turn off tailored experiences and inking data
description: Stops Windows from using your diagnostic data for tips and ads, and from collecting what you type and write.

title: Stop feedback prompts
description: Windows stops asking you for feedback.

title: Turn off location services
description: Windows and apps can no longer see where you are. Maps, weather and "find my device" will not know your location.

title: Turn off Windows Error Reporting
description: Crash reports are no longer collected and sent to Microsoft, and the reporting dialog no longer appears.

title: Disable telemetry scheduled tasks
description: Turns off background tasks that collect and send usage data (Customer Experience program, disk check data, feedback, error reporting). Tasks your Windows does not have are skipped.
details:
Disables these tasks (only those that exist), and re-enables only the ones MyTune disabled:
\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser, ProgramDataUpdater (not on every Windows build)
\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator, UsbCeip
\Microsoft\Windows\Autochk\Proxy
\Microsoft\Windows\Feedback\Siuf\DmClient, DmClientOnScenarioDownload
\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting\QueueReporting

title: Xbox services to Manual
description: Xbox Live, game save sync and accessory services only start when something needs them. Games that sign in to Xbox Live still work.
details:
Services XblAuthManager, XblGameSave, XboxGipSvc, XboxNetApiSvc: Automatic → Manual (never Disabled). Only those currently set to Automatic are changed.
These services are already Manual on a default Windows install, so this can read as on without MyTune changing anything. Turning it off then changes nothing.

title: Print Spooler to Manual
description: Windows no longer starts the Print Spooler at boot. Printing may not work until the service is started. Leave this off if you use a printer.
details: Service Spooler: Automatic → Manual (never Disabled). It has no service triggers, so it may need to be started by hand before printing. Your previous start type is restored when you turn this off.

title: Disable OneDrive
description: Stops OneDrive from syncing and starting with Windows. Does not uninstall it or delete your files, and you can turn it back on here.

title: Remove Teams chat icon
description: Removes the Chat (Teams) button from the taskbar on Windows versions that still have it. Explorer restarts.

title: Disable Microsoft Store (aggressive)
description: Sets the policy that blocks the Store app. On Windows Pro this policy may do nothing. Where it works, Store and Xbox app games cannot be installed or updated while this is on. Revert to get it back.

title: Activate G-SYNC
description: Keeps G-SYNC / variable refresh enabled in the NVIDIA driver. It is usually already on. Turn it off only if your fps stays far above your refresh rate and you accept screen tearing for slightly lower latency (competitive play).
details: NVIDIA driver, global Base Profile: Enable G-SYNC globally, Toggle the VRR global feature, VRR requested state. On = NVIDIA's defaults (enabled). Off = all three set to 0.

title: Variable refresh rate for windowed games
description: G-SYNC and FreeSync also work in borderless and windowed games, not just exclusive fullscreen. Needs a variable-refresh monitor.
details: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences: DirectXUserGlobalSettings gets VRROptimizeEnable=1; (other entries in that value are kept)

title: Auto HDR
description: Windows adds HDR to supported DirectX 11 and 12 games that were made for standard range. Needs an HDR display with HDR turned on in Windows.
details: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences: DirectXUserGlobalSettings gets AutoHDREnable=2097; (other entries in that value are kept)

title: Turn off Delivery Optimization
description: Stops your PC from sharing Windows update files with other PCs over your internet connection.

title: Keep Windows Update away from drivers
description: Windows Update no longer installs driver updates for any device, including your graphics card. Update drivers yourself from the device maker.

title: No automatic restarts after updates
description: Asks Windows not to restart by itself while you are signed in. It only takes effect with scheduled automatic installs, so it has no effect while "Disable automatic Windows Update" is on.
details:
HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU: NoAutoRebootWithLoggedOnUsers = 1
Microsoft documents this policy for scheduled installs only (AUOptions = 4). MyTune does not set AUOptions here.

title: Faster shutdown
description: Shortens the wait for hung apps and services at shutdown to 2 seconds and ends apps that block shutdown without asking. Unsaved work in those apps can be lost.
details:
HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop: WaitToKillAppTimeout = 2000, HungAppTimeout = 2000, AutoEndTasks = 1
HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control: WaitToKillServiceTimeout = 2000

title: Instant menus
description: Menus open with no delay.

title: Remove startup app delay
description: Windows starts your startup apps right away instead of waiting about 10 seconds after sign-in.

title: Turn off USB selective suspend
description: Sets a USB driver value meant to stop Windows from powering down USB devices (mouse, keyboard, headset) to save energy. Your USB ports are not disabled. The value is not officially documented, so the effect can vary.

title: Faster keyboard response
description: Shortens the delay before a held key starts repeating and sets the repeat rate to its fastest value.

title: Enable long file paths
description: Lets apps that declare long-path support use file paths longer than 260 characters. Other apps keep the old limit.

title: Open File Explorer to This PC
description: Explorer opens to your drives instead of Home with recent files.

title: Remove Home and Gallery from Explorer
description: Takes the Home and Gallery entries out of the Explorer sidebar. Explorer restarts.

title: Show seconds in the taskbar clock
description: The clock shows seconds. Explorer restarts.

title: Turn off search highlights
description: Removes the daily doodles and trending pictures from the search box.

title: Stop accessibility key pop-ups
description: Pressing Shift five times, holding Shift or holding Num Lock no longer opens Sticky Keys, Filter Keys or Toggle Keys prompts while you play. If you use one of these features, this also turns it off until you turn this off.
details:
HKCU\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys: Flags = 506
HKCU\Control Panel\Accessibility\Keyboard Response: Flags = 122
HKCU\Control Panel\Accessibility\ToggleKeys: Flags = 58

title: Faster hover tooltips
description: Tooltips appear sooner.

title: Tidy the right-click menu
description: Removes Share, Give access to and Include in library from the right-click menu. Explorer restarts.
details: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Shell Extensions\Blocked: adds {E2BF9676-5F8F-435C-97EB-11607A5BEDF7} (Share), {F81E9010-6EA4-11CE-A7FF-00AA003CA9F6} (Give access to), {3DAD6C5D-2167-4CAE-9914-F99E41C12CFA} (Include in library)

title: Add "Take ownership" to the right-click menu
description: Adds a right-click entry on files and folders. After the Windows admin prompt, the Administrators group becomes the owner and gets full access. Do not use it on Windows or Program Files folders.
details:
Creates HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\*\shell\MyTuneTakeOwn and HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\Directory\shell\MyTuneTakeOwn, which start MyTune.exe --take-own on the item. MyTune then runs takeown and icacls: owner and full access go to the Administrators group (S-1-5-32-544), not your own account.
Folders include everything inside them. Junctions and symbolic links are changed themselves, not followed.
The entry points at this copy of MyTune: if you move MyTune, turn this off and on again.
Turning this off deletes these keys and the older MyTuneTakeOwnership keys. Owners and permissions already changed on files stay as they are.

title: Dark theme
description: Dark mode for Windows and apps.

title: Block ads in Chrome and Edge
description: Adds the uBlock Origin Lite ad blocker to Chrome and Edge through browser policy. The browser then says "Managed by your organization"; turning this off removes the blocker again.
details: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Google\Chrome\ExtensionInstallForcelist and HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge\ExtensionInstallForcelist: uBlock Origin Lite in the first free slot

title: Transparent Start menu
description: Makes the Start menu see-through, only its edge stays, also while you type a search. It lasts while MyTune runs; the normal Start menu comes back when you turn this off or close MyTune.
details: MyTune loads a small helper into the Start menu (StartMenuExperienceHost.exe) and the search panel (SearchHost.exe) that clears their background brushes. Nothing in Windows is changed for good.

title: Stats beside Search
description: Shows live CPU, graphics, memory, disk and network use in a small panel beside the Start menu and Search while one of them is open. It lasts while MyTune runs.
details: MyTune watches which window is in front and reads the size of the Start or Search panel through Windows' accessibility interface. Nothing is loaded into them and no Windows setting changes.

title: Outline-only selection
description: Removes the blue fill from the box you drag to select files in File Explorer and on the desktop, so only a thin outline in your Windows highlight colour shows. It lasts while MyTune runs.
details: MyTune loads a small helper into Windows Explorer that skips the fill when the selection box is drawn. Folder windows that run in a separate Explorer process keep the normal box. Nothing in Windows is changed for good.

title: Selection border color
description: Sets the color of the box you drag to select files in File Explorer and on the desktop. Use the brush to choose it. Windows shares this color, so it also recolors selected text and menu highlights in many apps.
details: HKCU\Control Panel\Colors: Hilight = the chosen color, applied at once with SetSysColors. Explorer\Advanced: ListviewAlphaSelect = 1, so the desktop draws the colored box. Turning this off restores both originals.

title: Outline when moving windows
description: Shows only a frame while you drag or resize a window, instead of moving the whole window. Lighter on the GPU.

title: Turn off web results in Start search
description: Searching from Start only shows your PC, with no Bing web results. File Explorer's search box also stops suggesting past searches. Explorer restarts.

title: Hide Start menu recommendations
description: Turns off Start's recommendations for tips, shortcuts and new apps. Recent files can still appear. Explorer restarts.

title: Clean Start menu
description: Start shows only the search box and what you pin: no app list, no recommendations (Windows Pro may still show them), all pins removed.
details:
You then open apps through search or your own pins. While this is on, the Windows setting for the app list in Start is locked. Switching it off puts your old pins back; pins you made in between are dropped. Explorer restarts.
HKCU\...\Policies\Explorer: NoStartMenuMorePrograms = 1
HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer: empty pin list, recommendations, recently added and most used apps hidden
HKCU\...\Explorer\Advanced and ...\Start: account notifications, websites, recent and frequent lists off
Pin file start2.bin: saved to %ProgramData%\MyTune\start2.bin.bak, then deleted

title: Align taskbar icons to the left
description: Moves the taskbar icons and Start button to the left like Windows 10.

title: Hide the taskbar search button
description: Removes the search box or icon from the taskbar. Search still opens with the Windows key.

title: Hide the Task View button
description: Removes the Task View button from the taskbar. Win + Tab still works.

title: Show file extensions
description: Shows .exe, .txt and other extensions in File Explorer.

title: Show hidden files and folders
description: Shows hidden files and folders in File Explorer.

title: Turn off window snapping
description: Dragging a window to a screen edge no longer arranges it. Applies after you sign out.

title: Turn off the snap layout flyout
description: Hovering the maximize button no longer shows layout suggestions.

title: Turn off snap assist suggestions
description: After snapping a window, Windows no longer suggests other windows to fill the rest of the screen.

title: NumLock on at startup
description: Turns NumLock on at the sign-in screen and after sign-in. Windows can rewrite this value at sign-out or shutdown.

title: Verbose sign-in messages
description: Shows what Windows is doing during startup, sign-in and shutdown.

title: Detailed crash screen
description: Asks Windows to show technical error details on the crash screen. On Windows 11 24H2 and later this may have no effect.

title: Hide the Settings home page
description: Opens Settings on System instead of the Home page with suggestions. Replaces any list of hidden Settings pages you already set.
